start_instant.description: OS process start instant (ProcessHandle.info().startInstant()); with pid the liveness identity.

version.description: Release version of the running binary.

listener.description: Listener in use: the Quarkus domain socket, fallback (1) loopback TCP, or fallback (2) the own JDK socket listener (Runtime Model, Transport Endpoint); reported in the runtime status.

socket_path.description: The socket path <PM_MCP_BASE>/run/runtime.sock, which has no alternative location (a path over the sun_path limit refuses the start); for listener loopback_tcp the address 127.0.0.1:<port>.
